title: General Self-Similarity: An Overview
abstract: Self-similarity is a property of objects that appear the same at different scales. It has been studied in various fields, from mathematics to nature. This paper provides an overview of self-similarity, its mathematical foundations, and applications. The use of self-similarity in signal processing, image compression, and other domains is discussed, highlighting the importance of this concept in both theoretical research and practical applications.
summary:

The paper outlines the mathematical foundations and significant applications of self-similarity, emphasizing its role in practical areas like image compression and signal processing.
